expectations.note: After clearing preferences and restarting, the Dot hero showed only its centered dot and no artist/title overlay.
The enabled toggle survived a restart and the restarted Dot view rendered the long artist/title overlay.
After toggling off, pausing, and restarting, the Dot hero again showed the dot without an artist/title overlay.
At confirmed 100%, both 68-character metadata fields rendered fully within the hero with intentional artist ellipsis and no visible collision.
At confirmed 150%, the 68-character fields were legibly contained and did not visibly clip or collide.
The submitted normal-scale screenshot exists but its artist and title are each under the rubric's 60-character long-metadata threshold.
The submitted maximum-scale screenshot exists but likewise uses metadata shorter than the required roughly 60 characters per field.
The maximum-scale verification structurally reports the non-empty long artist and title, and the paired 100% capture did the same.
Short metadata remained readable at both scales, but enabling song info removes the normally centered Dot circle, a visible common-case layout regression.
The final live verification remained responsive with a playing ordinary track and no overflow reports.
